author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections
source: AI translation parts with source-bound posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: TU-100 7.5 g/d was not associated with a statistically significant difference for GI recovery (HR 1.17 [95% CI, 0.91-1.50]).
translations.translation_ko: TU-100 7.5 g/일은 위장관 회복에서 통계적으로 유의한 차이와 관련되지 않았다(HR 1.17, 95% CI 0.91-1.50).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Nutrition alone resulted in significant weight retention (2.60; 2.32, 2.88, p < 0.00001), length of stay (-4.00; -6.87, -1.13), p = 0.0006) and complications (0.64; 0.49, 0.83, p = 0.0009).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: In this trial, perioperative immunonutrition with arginine and omega-3 fatty acids did not improve postoperative clinical outcomes or inflammatory markers in patients undergoing gastrointestinal cancer surgery.
translations.translation_ko: 이 시험에서 아르기닌과 오메가-3 지방산을 포함한 수술 전후 면역영양은 위장관암 수술 환자의 수술 후 임상결과나 염증표지자를 개선하지 못했다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: More patients reported adverse effects with midazolam 15 mg.
translations.translation_ko: 미다졸람 15 mg 을 쓴 쪽에서 이상반응을 말한 사람이 더 많았습니다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: Physical and nutritional prehabilitation in older patients with CRC has not shown a significant reduction in postoperative complications or length of stay.
translations.translation_ko: 고령 대장암 환자가 수술 전에 운동과 영양 준비를 했을 때 수술 후 합병증이나 입원 기간이 뚜렷하게 줄지는 않았습니다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: There was no difference in the response rate or frequency of serious adverse events between the two arms.
translations.translation_ko: 반응률과 중대한 이상반응 빈도는 두 군 사이에 차이가 없었습니다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: CONCLUSION: Blood vitamin levels decreased when patients were administered PPN without vitamin supplementation during the first week after surgery.
translations.translation_ko: 결론: 수술 후 첫 주에 비타민 보충 없이 말초정맥영양을 투여한 환자에서는 혈중 비타민 수치가 감소했다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Cost savings were typically associated with significantly improved outcomes, demonstrated through the following meta-analyses: reduced mortality (Risk ratio 0.650, P < 0.05; N = 5 studies), reduced complications (by 35% of the total; P < 0.001, N = 7 studies) and reduced length of hospital stay (by ∼2 days, P < 0.05; N = 5 surgical studies) corresponding to ∼13.0% reduction in hospital stay.
translations.translation_ko: 비용 절감은 대체로 유의하게 개선된 결과와 연관됐으며, 메타분석에서 사망률 감소(RR 0.650, P<0.05; 5개 연구), 합병증 35% 감소(P<0.001; 7개 연구), 입원 기간 약 2일 감소(P<0.05; 수술 연구 5개, 입원 기간 약 13% 감소)를 보였습니다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: SmofKabiven® was comparable to hospital-compounded PN in improving postoperative nutritional status and safety profile and its enrichment with omega-3 fatty acids and taurine may provide additional benefits.
translations.translation_ko: SmofKabiven®은 수술 후 영양상태 개선과 안전성에서 병원 조제 정맥영양과 비슷했으며, 오메가-3 지방산과 타우린 강화가 추가 이점을 제공할 수 있다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Chemotherapy completion was significantly higher in the JPBS group than in the placebo group (63.0 % vs. 47.6 %, P = 0.003).
translations.translation_ko: JPBS군의 항암치료 완료율은 위약군보다 유의하게 높았다(63.0% 대 47.6%, P=0.003).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Supportive psychotherapy in "low-functioning" patients, (home) rehabilitation programmes and nutritional supplementation appeared to have beneficial effects on HS.
translations.translation_ko: 저기능 환자에서 지지적 심리치료, 가정 재활 프로그램, 영양 보충은 건강상태에 유익한 효과를 보였다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: The results indicate that, compared to the sole conventional placebo treatment, the use of TSF treatment after 24 weeks shows significant improvement in the experimental group over the control group, with UAER (MD=-15.94(95% CI: -30.67-1.22); P=0.03) and 24h UP (MD=-0.20(95% CI:-0.36-0.05);P=0.01); assessment of eGFR and scores showed no significant changes in the levels of these two indicators in patients, e GFR (MD=-4.95(95% CI: -11.52-1.62); P=0.47) and scores (MD=0.35(95% CI: -1.29-1.98);P=0.92).
translations.translation_ko: 24주 후 TSF군은 대조군보다 UAER와 24시간 요단백에서 유의한 개선을 보였지만, eGFR과 점수에는 유의한 변화가 없었다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: This meta-analysis demonstrated clinically meaningful efficacy favoring the Niaoduqing Granule group (RR = 1.249; 95% CIs = 1.169-1.335; p < 0.001), with safety analyses across three trials revealing comparable adverse event rates (R = 1.303; 95% CIs = 0.589-2.884; p = 0.514; I 2 = 0.0%).
translations.translation_ko: 이 메타분석에서는 니아오두칭 과립군의 임상적으로 의미 있는 효과가 우세했습니다(RR=1.249, 95% CI 1.169~1.335, p<0.001). 3개 시험의 안전성 분석에서는 이상반응률이 비슷했습니다(R=1.303, 95% CI 0.589~2.884, p=0.514; I²=0.0%).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: RESULTS: Values of blood protein until day 8 were similar in 2 groups although those of vitamins B1, B6, C, and folic acid (contained more in OPF-109) were higher in the OPF-109 group.
translations.translation_ko: 결과: 8일까지 혈중 단백질 수치는 두 군이 비슷했지만, 비타민 B1·B6·C와 엽산 수치는 OPF-109군에서 더 높았다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: RESULTS: In both trials, Hgb concentration was maintained from baseline to EoT in the FPC group but decreased by 0.4 g/dL in the placebo group (P < 0.001, combined results; 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.2-0.6).
translations.translation_ko: 두 연구 모두 FPC군의 Hgb 농도는 기저치부터 연구 종료 시점까지 유지됐지만 위약군에서는 0.4 g/dL 감소했습니다(P<0.001; 통합 결과 95% 신뢰구간 0.2~0.6).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: CONCLUSION: Nutritional vitamin D supplementation may improve microinflammation and nutritional status in MHD patients, with potential benefits for bone metabolism and no apparent increase in the risk of hypercalcemia or hyperphosphatemia.
translations.translation_ko: 결론: 영양학적 비타민 D 보충은 혈액투석 환자의 미세염증과 영양상태를 개선할 수 있고, 고칼슘혈증이나 고인산혈증 위험을 뚜렷하게 높이지 않으면서 뼈 대사에도 이득이 있을 수 있다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Dopaminergic agents are beneficial but limited by higher adverse event risks, while iron therapy offers moderate benefits with good tolerability.
translations.translation_ko: 도파민 작용제는 유익하지만 이상반응 위험이 더 높다는 제한이 있고, 철분 치료는 내약성이 양호하면서 중등도 이득을 보였다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Ferric citrate decreased the serum phosphorus level to 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L, comparable to 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L by sevelamer carbonate.
translations.translation_ko: 구연산철은 혈청 인 수치를 0.59 ± 0.54 mmol/L로 낮췄고, 세벨라머 탄산염의 0.56 ± 0.62 mmol/L와 비슷했다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: CONCLUSION: In patients with type 2 diabetes, stage 2 to 3 CKD and macroalbuminuria, add-on astragalus for 48 weeks further stabilized kidney function on top of standard care.
translations.translation_ko: 결론: 제2형 당뇨병, 2-3기 CKD, 거대알부민뇨 환자에서 48주간 황기를 추가하면 표준치료에 더해 신장기능이 안정화되었다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: According to high-quality studies, turmeric and curcumin demonstrated antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits in HD patients; however, these compounds did not exhibit a lipid-lowering effect.
translations.translation_ko: 질 높은 연구에서 강황과 커큐민은 혈액투석 환자에게 항산화·항염 효과를 보였지만 지질 저하 효과는 보이지 않았다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: While findings were mixed, several prospective studies suggested that high daily FA intake (≥800 μg) or prolonged use (>3-6 months) may be associated with increased odds of GDM, especially when initiated preconceptionally.
translations.translation_ko: 결과는 엇갈렸지만, 여러 전향적 연구에서 엽산을 매일 800 µg 이상 또는 3~6개월을 초과해 복용하면, 특히 임신 전 시작했을 때 임신성 당뇨병 발생 오즈가 높아질 수 있다고 제시했습니다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: The results showed that DHA and/or EPA supplementation doses >650 mg/day resulted in slightly higher birth weight (MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n = 3,831) and combined BMI and BMI z score at 5-10 years (SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n = 3,220).
translations.translation_ko: DHA 및/또는 EPA를 하루 650 mg 초과 보충한 경우 출생체중(MD 87.5 g, 95% CI 52.3-122.6, n=3,831)과 5-10세의 BMI 및 BMI z 점수(SMD 0.11, 95% CI 0.04-0.18, n=3,220)가 약간 더 높았다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: At the overall level, observational studies adjusted for confounding did not show significant associations between prenatal herbal medicine use and major adverse offspring outcomes (including birth defects, miscarriage, stillbirth, or preterm birth).
translations.translation_ko: 전체적으로 교란요인을 보정한 관찰연구에서는 임신 중 허브 사용과 주요 자녀 이상 결과(선천성 기형, 유산, 사산, 조산 포함)의 유의한 연관성이 나타나지 않았다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: RESULTS: Women receiving the higher dose of DHA (800 mg/d) during pregnancy had lower HR, lower sympathetic index, higher vagally mediated HRV indices, and greater HRV complexity when compared with the women who received the lower dose (200 mg/d; all P < 0.05).
translations.translation_ko: 임신 중 DHA 800 mg/d를 받은 여성은 200 mg/d를 받은 여성보다 심박수와 교감신경 지수가 낮고, 미주신경 매개 심박변이도 지표와 심박변이도 복잡성이 높았습니다(모두 P<0.05).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: From RCTs, there was no clear evidence for an effect of prenatal multiple micronutrient supplementation on the risk of miscarriage (8 RCTs; risk ratio (RR): 0.87; 95% CI 0.75, 1.02; moderate certainty of evidence) or stillbirth (15 RCTs; RR: 0.86; 95% CI 0.73, 1.02; low certainty of evidence).
translations.translation_ko: 무작위시험에서는 임신 중 복합 미량영양소 보충이 유산 위험에 영향을 준다는 명확한 근거가 없었습니다(8개 시험, RR 0.87, 95% CI 0.75~1.02; 근거 확실성 중간). 사산 위험도 마찬가지였습니다(15개 시험, RR 0.86, 95% CI 0.73~1.02; 근거 확실성 낮음).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Maternal alcohol consumption during preconception/pregnancy, maternal intake of vitamin and folic acid during pregnancy, paternal occupational exposure to extremely low-frequency magnetic fields (ELF-MF), and maternal X-ray exposure during pregnancy were also not associated with the risk of NB.
translations.translation_ko: 임신 전·임신 중 모체의 음주, 임신 중 모체의 비타민·엽산 섭취, 부계의 극저주파 자기장 직업 노출, 임신 중 모체의 X선 노출은 신경모세포종 위험과도 연관되지 않았다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Notably, the protective effect of folic acid supplementation was reported in cases of congenital heart disease linked to dihydrofolate reductase inhibitors but not that associated with antiepileptic drugs.
translations.translation_ko: 특히 엽산 보충의 보호효과는 디하이드로엽산 환원효소 억제제와 연관된 선천성 심장질환에서 보고됐지만, 항간질약과 연관된 질환에서는 보고되지 않았다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Although LE containing olive +/or fish oil show promise with regards to liver function and blood and cell fatty acid profiles, further studies are needed before drawing definitive conclusions on the clinical value of these emulsions.
translations.translation_ko: 올리브유 및/또는 어유를 포함한 지질 유제는 간기능과 혈액·세포 지방산 지표에서 가능성을 보이지만, 이 유제의 임상적 가치를 확정하려면 추가 연구가 필요하다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: The evidence indicates considerable uncertainty about effects of nutritional supplementation compared to no additional intervention on all clinical outcomes for people with non-alcohol-related fatty liver disease.
translations.translation_ko: 저자 결론: 비알코올성 지방간 환자에서 추가 중재가 없는 경우와 비교한 영양 보충의 모든 임상결과 효과에는 상당한 불확실성이 있다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Moreover, the serum levels of aspartate aminotransferase (p = 0.015) and alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.004) at 6-week intervals, and the serum level of alkaline phosphatase (p = 0.002) at 9-week intervals were significantly lower in the silymarin group.ConclusionOral formulation of silymarin 420 mg/day for 63 days significantly prevented hepatotoxicity caused by doxorubicin in patients with non-metastatic breast cancer mostly based on liver ultrasonography but not laboratory parameters.
translations.translation_ko: 실리마린 경구제 420 mg/day 63일은 비전이성 유방암 환자에서 독소루비신으로 인한 간독성을 유의하게 예방했는데, 주로 간 초음파에 근거했고 검사실 지표에는 근거가 없었습니다. 혈청 AST(p=0.015)와 ALP(p=0.004)는 6주 간격에서, ALP(p=0.002)는 9주 간격에서 실리마린군이 유의하게 낮았습니다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Probiotics/synbiotics were associated with a significant reduction in alanine aminotransferase activity [ALT, weighted mean difference (WMD): -11.23 IU/L; 95% CI: -15.02, -7.44 IU/L] and liver stiffness measurement (LSM) by elastography (reflecting inflammation and fibrosis) (WMD: -0.70 kPa; 95% CI: -1.00, -0.40 kPa), although analyses showed heterogeneity (I2 = 90.6% and I2 = 93.4%, respectively).
translations.translation_ko: 프로바이오틱스·신바이오틱스는 ALT 활성(WMD -11.23 IU/L, 95% CI -15.02~-7.44)과 탄성측정법으로 측정한 간 경직도(염증·섬유화를 반영)(WMD -0.70 kPa, 95% CI -1.00~-0.40)의 유의한 감소와 연관됐지만, 분석 이질성이 높았습니다(I²=90.6% 및 93.4%).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: RESULTS: Meta-analysis indicated that microbial therapies significantly reduced BMI (-0.37 kg/m2; 95% confidence interval [CI], -0.46 to -0.28; P < 0.001), hepatic enzymes (ALT, -6.9 U/L [95%CI, -9.4 to -4.3]; AST, -4.6 U/L [95%CI, -6.6 to -2.7]; γ-GT, -7.9 U/L [95%CI, -11.4 to -4.4]; P < 0.001), serum cholesterol (-10.1 mg/dL 95%CI, -13.6 to -6.6; P < 0.001), LDL-c (-4.5 mg/dL; 95%CI, -8.9 to -0.17; P < 0.001), and TAG (-10.1 mg/dL; 95%CI, -18.0 to -2.3; P < 0.001), but not inflammation (TNF-α, -2.0 ng/mL; [95%CI, -4.7 to 0.61]; CRP, -0.74 mg/L [95%CI, -1.9 to 0.37]).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: Probiotics and synbiotics significantly improve liver enzymes and hepatic steatosis in patients with MASLD.
translations.translation_ko: 결론: 프로바이오틱스와 신바이오틱스는 MASLD 환자의 간효소와 지방간을 유의하게 개선한다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: CONCLUSION: In adults with T2DM and MASLD, add-on trials show directionally favorable pooled biochemical/metabolic changes after unified effect harmonization, but uncertainty remains substantial.
translations.translation_ko: 결론: 제2형 당뇨병과 MASLD 성인의 추가요법 시험은 효과 방향을 통일한 뒤 생화학·대사 지표의 통합 변화가 유리한 방향이지만 불확실성이 상당함을 보였다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: TCM formulations may provide symptomatic and metabolic benefits for MASLD with acceptable safety and identifiable core herbs; however, evidence certainty is very low due to pervasive poor methodological quality of included RCTs, which severely undermines confidence in findings.
translations.translation_ko: 결론: TCM 제제는 MASLD에서 수용 가능한 안전성과 확인 가능한 핵심 약초를 바탕으로 증상·대사 이득을 줄 수 있지만, 포함된 무작위시험의 전반적인 방법론적 질이 낮아 근거 확실성이 매우 낮고 결과에 대한 신뢰가 크게 떨어진다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Meta-analysis showed that YGJ or its modified versions, combined with Western medical supportive treatments, significantly increased treatment effectiveness (OR = 1.84, 95% CI: 1.32-2.58), improved Karnofsky performance status score (MD = 7.00, 95% CI: 4.80-9.21), decreased serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) (SMD = -0.36, 95% CI: -0.58 to -0.14), improved TCM syndrome scores (MD = -3.10, 95% CI: -3.78 to -2.42), reduced total bilirubin (MD = -1.52, 95% CI: -2.25 to -0.78), and lowered gastrointestinal adverse reactions (OR = 0.53, 95% CI: 0.33-0.84).
translations.translation_ko: 서양의학 보조치료와 병용한 YGJ 또는 변형 처방은 치료 효과를 유의하게 높였고(OR=1.84, 95% CI 1.32~2.58), Karnofsky 수행능력 점수를 개선했으며(MD=7.00, 95% CI 4.80~9.21), 혈청 AFP(SMD=-0.36, 95% CI -0.58~-0.14), TCM 증후군 점수(MD=-3.10, 95% CI -3.78~-2.42), 총빌리루빈(MD=-1.52, 95% CI -2.25~-0.78)을 낮추고 위장관 이상반응도 줄였습니다(OR=0.53, 95% CI 0.33~0.84).
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: CONCLUSION: The current study suggests that antioxidant and probiotic/symbiotic/prebiotic supplements may be a promising regimen for NAFLD patients.
translations.translation_ko: 결론: 이 연구는 항산화제와 프로바이오틱·신바이오틱·프리바이오틱 보충제가 비알코올성 지방간 환자에게 유망한 요법일 수 있음을 시사한다.
translations.author: Claude; gpt-5.6-luna posthoc corrections

translations.source_text: Prebiotics had no significant effects on AST and ALT levels (ES, -2.96; 95%CI, -8.12, 2.18, P = 0.259; and ES, -4.69; 95%CI, -13.53, 4.15, P = 0.299, respectively).
translations.translation_ko: 프리바이오틱은 AST와 ALT 수치에 유의한 영향을 주지 않았다(각각 ES -2.96, 95% CI -8.12~2.18, P=0.259; ES -4.69, 95% CI -13.53~4.15, P=0.299).

translations.source_text: CONCLUSIONS: IPE 4 g/day did not significantly change the single-dose AUC(0-∞) or C(max) of R- and S-warfarin or the anticoagulation pharmacodynamics of warfarin when co-administered as racemic warfarin at 25 mg.
translations.translation_ko: 이코사펜트 에틸(IPE) 4 g/day를 라세미체 와파린 25 mg과 병용해도 R·S-와파린의 단회 투여 AUC(0-∞) 또는 Cmax, 그리고 와파린의 항응고 약력학은 유의하게 변하지 않았습니다.

translations.source_text: The administration of vitamin K in hospitalized patients with CLD resulted in minimal INR change, suggesting this intervention may not have the intended benefit of reducing bleeding risk.
